Home / About Us

Three and a half decades of forming metal.

Aarvi Industries is a professional tin and metal container manufacturing company based in Anand, Gujarat, serving industrial and consumer packaging customers across India.

Who We Are

Formed on our own tooling, since 1987.

Aarvi Industries was founded in 1987 in Anand, Gujarat, with a single focus: forming tin plate into containers that protect what's inside them. What began as a small trading and job-work unit has grown into a full-scale manufacturing facility supplying industrial and consumer packaging across India.

Every container we make is drawn from tested tin plate stock and formed on our own tooling — which means tighter tolerances, consistent seams, and lead times we control end to end.

Our approach to custom container work starts with understanding what the product inside actually needs — fill line, seal type, stacking load, transit distance — and carries through from concept drawing to tooling, forming, and dispatch, all under one roof in Anand.

1987

Company founded

Started as a tin container trading & job-work unit in Anand, Gujarat.

2004

In-house tool room added

Brought die-making and tooling in-house for faster turnaround on custom sizes.

2016

Scaled to full manufacturing

Expanded press capacity to supply paint, chemical and lubricant packaging brands pan-India.

Today

Supplying nationally

Serving customers across India with a standing range of 15 capacities, plus custom work.

Home / Capabilities

Our manufacturing capabilities.

From coil to finished container, every step happens on our own press lines in Anand — so tolerances, timelines and quality stay in our hands.

On the Shop Floor

Formed, seamed and checked in-house.

Quality on a tin container is decided long before it reaches the fill line. We control the plate, the tooling and the seam, all on site.

  • 01
    Coil to blankTin plate coil is slit and cut to blank size on site.
  • 02
    Press formingBlanks are drawn and formed on in-house tooling and dies.
  • 03
    Seaming & finishingBodies are seamed, rimmed and lithographed or plain-finished.
  • 04
    Inspection & dispatchEvery batch is checked before it's packed for dispatch.

Want to see the full process in action?

Get in touch to arrange a walkthrough of our production line or discuss a custom tooling requirement.

Home / Quality

Quality you can trust.

Quality on a tin container is decided long before it reaches the fill line — in the plate that's chosen, the die that forms it, and the seam that closes it. We control all three in-house.

Our Quality Commitment

Checked at every stage, not just the last one.

  • 01
    Incoming material inspectionEvery coil of tin plate is checked for gauge, coating and surface finish before it enters production.
  • 02
    In-house tool roomDies and tooling are built and maintained on site, so tolerances stay consistent order after order.
  • 03
    Seam & leak testingFormed containers are tested for seam integrity so what goes in stays in during transit.
  • 04
    Dispatch on scheduleProduction is planned against your fill-line date, not just our press schedule.

What We Check

Six checkpoints, every batch.

Privacy Policy

How Aarvi Industries collects, uses and protects the information you share with us.

What We Collect

We only collect information you choose to give us. When you submit the enquiry form on this website, we receive your full name, company name (if provided), email address, phone number (if provided), the capacity or product you're asking about, and the message you write. We do not use cookies, analytics trackers, or any other method to collect information about you without your knowledge, and we do not require you to create an account or log in to use this site.

How We Use It

Your enquiry details are used for one purpose only: to respond to your request for a quote or information, and to keep a record of that conversation so our team can follow up correctly. We do not sell, rent, or trade your information to any third party for marketing purposes.

How Your Enquiry Is Delivered

This website does not run its own server or database. When you submit the form, your details are passed through Formspree, a third-party form-processing service, which forwards them by email to our team. Formspree acts as our data processor for this single purpose — you can read their own privacy policy at formspree.io. Beyond that, your message is stored in our team's email inbox like any other business correspondence.

Fonts and External Resources

This site loads its typefaces from Google Fonts. Loading a page here may cause your browser to request those fonts directly from Google's servers, which is standard practice for most modern websites. We do not control what Google does with that request.

Data Retention

We keep enquiry correspondence for as long as reasonably needed to handle your request and maintain our business records, and no longer than necessary for that purpose.

Your Rights

You can ask us at any time what information we hold about you, ask us to correct it, or ask us to delete it, subject to any legal or accounting requirement that may require us to keep certain records. To do so, contact us using the details below.

Security

We take reasonable steps to protect the information you share with us, including relying on Formspree's security practices for form delivery and restricting access to our email inbox to authorised staff. No method of transmission over the internet is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

Changes to This Policy

We may update this policy from time to time as our website or practices change. The version published on this page is the one currently in effect.

Contact

Questions about this policy, or requests regarding your data, can be sent to .

This policy is provided as a good-faith description of our current practices and is not a substitute for legal advice. We recommend having it reviewed by a qualified professional to confirm it meets applicable data protection laws before relying on it.
